title: Minimalne slike i statička analiza
summary: Kako napraviti minimalnu i bezbjednu sliku kontejnera (distroless, multi-stage, non-root, pinovani digest) i kako statičkom analizom (kubesec, kube-linter, trivy config, hadolint i ručni pregled) naći opasne postavke u manifestima i Dockerfileovima.
summary_en: How to build a minimal, secure container image (distroless, multi-stage, non-root, pinned digest) and how to use static analysis (kubesec, kube-linter, trivy config, hadolint and manual review) to find dangerous settings in manifests and Dockerfiles.
